entity_name: Council for Development and Reconstruction (مجلس الإنماء والإعمار)
parent_ministry: Presidency of the Council of Ministers

facts.value: Plans, finances, and supervises major national development and reconstruction projects. Acts as project owner for capital infrastructure (roads, water, buildings). NOT a day-to-day field service entity — escalation/project complaints only. Complaint domains encoded for routing: active_CDR_project_defect, infrastructure_project_complaint, reconstruction_zone_issue, project_worksite_hazard, CDR_contractor_violation, public_works_quality_complaint, CDR_funded_road_complaint, post_war_reconstruction_issue.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: routine_road_maintenance(MPWT); day_to_day_municipal_services(MUN); non_project_infrastructure; private_works; routine_road_maintenance_or_day_to_day_local_service; Route instead to MUN_OR_MPWT when CDR requires project-owner evidence.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national_project_sites. Use CDR only for explicit CDR/reconstruction/project-site signals or verified project owner evidence.
